title.en: Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3
title.raw: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四 Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3

sentences.zh: 開運二年夏五月丙申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaiyun, on the first day of the fifth month of summer, the day bingchen, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall to receive court, and granted a great amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of Kaiyun 2, on the first day of the fifth month (the day bingchen), the emperor received court in Chongyuan Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以右衛上將軍馬萬為左金吾上將軍致仕。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Ma Wan, General-in-Chief of the Right Guards, was made General-in-Chief of the Left Imperial Guards and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Ma Wan, formerly General-in-Chief of the Right Guards, was appointed General-in-Chief of the Left Imperial Guards and retired from active service.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，陜州節度使宋彥筠移鎮鄧州，澶州節度使何建移鎮河陽。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Song Yanyun, Military Commissioner of Shaan Prefecture, was transferred to command Deng Prefecture; He Jian, Military Commissioner of Chan Prefecture, was transferred to command Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Song Yanyun was moved from Shaan to Deng Prefecture, and He Jian from Chan to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 以左神武統軍潘環為澶州節度使，以宣徽北院使李彥韜遙領壽州節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使，以滄州節度使田武遙領夔州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Pan Huan, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was made Military Commissioner of Chan Prefecture; Li Yantao, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Military Commissioner of Shou Prefecture in absentia and concurrently Commander of the Palace Cavalry; Tian Wu, Military Commissioner of Cang Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Kui Prefecture in absentia and concurrently Commander of the Palace Infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Huan was appointed Military Commissioner of Chan; Li Yantao was given Shou in absentia while retaining command of the palace cavalry; and Tian Wu was given Kui in absentia while retaining command of the palace infantry.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, a white rainbow was seen across the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬子，宰臣桑維翰、劉句、李崧、和凝並加階爵。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the chief ministers Sang Weihan, Liu Gou, Li Song, and He Ning were all advanced in rank and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, chief ministers Sang Weihan, Liu Gou, Li Song, and He Ning all received promotions in rank and title.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書竇貞固改刑部尚書，太常寺卿王松改工部尚書。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Rites, was changed to Minister of Justice; Wang Song, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was changed to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu moved from Minister of Rites to Minister of Justice, and Wang Song from Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左丞龍敏為太常卿；

translations.literal: Long Min, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;
translations.idiomatic: Long Min was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎李慎儀為尚書左丞；

translations.literal: Li Shenyi, Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shenyi, Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞張允為兵部侍郎、知制誥，充翰林學士承旨；

translations.literal: Zhang Yun, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of War and Drafter of Edicts, and appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yun, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of War and drafter of edicts, and appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief;

sentences.zh: 以左諫議大夫顏衎為御史中丞；

translations.literal: Yan Yan, Left Remonstrance Counselor, was made Censor-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: Yan Yan was appointed Censor-in-Chief;

sentences.zh: （《宋史·顏衎傳》：喪亂之後，朝綱不振，衎執憲頗有風采，嘗上言：「才除御史者旋授外藩賓佐，復有以私故細事求假外拜，州郡無參謁之儀，出入失風憲之體，漸恐四方得以輕易，百辟無所準繩。

translations.literal: (Biography of Yan Yan, History of Song: After the disorders of war, court discipline was slack; Yan, in enforcing the law, showed considerable authority. He once memorialized: "Those just appointed censors are immediately given posts as staff to outer prefectures; others seek leave to go out on petty private grounds. Prefectures have no protocol for audiences, and comings and goings lose the dignity proper to the censorate. Gradually the four quarters may take things lightly, and the hundred officials will have no standard to follow."
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Yan Yan: After the chaos of war, court discipline had grown lax; in office Yan enforced the law with real authority. He once submitted: "Censors are appointed one day and the next sent out as staff to frontier commands; others take petty leave on private grounds. Without proper audience protocol in the provinces, the censorate loses its dignity, the realm may come to hold it cheap, and officials will have no standard to follow."

sentences.zh: 請自今藩鎮幕僚，勿得任臺官；

translations.literal: "I ask that from now on staff of military commissioners may not hold censorate posts;
translations.idiomatic: "Henceforth let no staff member of a military commission hold a censorate post;

sentences.zh: 雖親王宰相出鎮，亦不得奏充賓佐；

translations.literal: even when imperial princes or chancellors go out to command, they may not be memorialized to fill staff posts;
translations.idiomatic: even when princes or chancellors take provincial commands, they must not be named to staff those posts;

sentences.zh: 非奉制勘事，勿得出京；

translations.literal: unless on imperial commission to investigate a matter, they may not leave the capital;
translations.idiomatic: and unless commissioned by edict to investigate, censors may not leave the capital;

sentences.zh: 自余不令釐雜務。

translations.literal: for the rest, do not allow them to take up miscellaneous duties."
translations.idiomatic: nor handle miscellaneous duties beyond their charge."

sentences.zh: 」詔惟辟召入幕，余從其請。）〉

translations.literal: An edict allowed only those summoned by invitation to enter staffs; the rest of his request was approved.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict allowed only personally invited staff appointments; the rest of his request was granted.))

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎、宏文館學士、判館事田敏為國子祭酒；

translations.literal: Tian Min, Vice Minister of War, Academician of the Hongwen Hall, and superintendent of the hall, was made Rector of the Directorate of Education;
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min was appointed Rector of the Directorate of Education;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎段希堯為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: Duan Xiyao was made Vice Minister of War;

sentences.zh: 以工部侍郎邊蔚為戶部侍郎，依前權知開封府事；

translations.literal: Bian Wei, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and continued as acting administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Bian Wei was made Vice Minister of Revenue while continuing to administer Kaifeng in an acting capacity;

sentences.zh: 以左散騎常侍李式為工部侍郎；

translations.literal: Li Shi, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi was made Vice Minister of Works;

sentences.zh: 以給事中王仁裕為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Wang Renyu, Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Renyu was appointed Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以華州節度使趙瑩為開封尹，以皇弟開封尹重睿為秦州節度使，以宣徽南院使劉繼勛為華州節度使，以前鄆州節度使張從恩為晉州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Zhao Ying, Military Commissioner of Hua Prefecture, was made Prefect of Kaifeng; the emperor's younger brother Chongrui, Prefect of Kaifeng, was made Military Commissioner of Qin Prefecture; Liu Jixun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Military Commissioner of Hua Prefecture; Zhang Cong'en, former Military Commissioner of Yan Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhao Ying became Prefect of Kaifeng; the emperor's brother Chongrui, who had held that post, was sent to Qin; Liu Jixun took Hua; and Zhang Cong'en was appointed to Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，杜威來朝。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Du Wei came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Du Wei presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 定州奏，大風雹，北嶽廟殿宇樹木悉摧拔之。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that in a great wind and hail, the halls and trees of the Northern Peak temple were all uprooted and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Prefecture reported that a violent hailstorm had uprooted the halls and trees of the Northern Peak temple.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑朔，帝御崇元殿，百官入閣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day, the day yichou, the emperor took the throne at Chongyuan Hall, and the hundred officials entered the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month (yichou), the emperor held court in Chongyuan Hall and the officials entered the inner audience.

sentences.zh: 監修國史劉句、史官張昭遠等以新修《唐書》紀、誌、列傳並目錄凡二百三卷上之。

translations.literal: Liu Gou, supervisor of the compilation of the national history, and the historiographer Zhang Zhaoyuan and others presented the newly compiled History of Tang—annals, treatises, biographies, and catalogue—in 203 juan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gou, who supervised the national history, and Zhang Zhaoyuan and other historiographers presented the newly compiled History of Tang—annals, treatises, biographies, and catalogue—in 203 juan.

sentences.zh: 賜器帛有差。

translations.literal: Ritual vessels and silks were bestowed in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards of vessels and silk were granted according to rank.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以恒州節度使杜威為天雄軍節度使，充鄴都留守；

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Du Wei, Military Commissioner of Heng Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and appointed to remain as defender of the Ye capital;
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Du Wei was moved from Heng to command the Tianxiong Army and serve as defender of the Ye capital;

sentences.zh: 以鄴都留守馬全節為恒州節度使；

translations.literal: Ma Quanjie, defender of the Ye capital, was made Military Commissioner of Heng Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Quanjie, defender of Ye, was appointed to Heng;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、金部郎中、知制誥徐臺符為中書舍人；

translations.literal: Xu Taifu, Hanlin academician, Director of the Gold Bureau, and drafter of edicts, was made Secretariat Drafter;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Taifu was appointed Secretariat Drafter;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、禮部郎中、知制誥李瀚為中書舍人；

translations.literal: Li Han, Hanlin academician, Director of the Rites Bureau, and drafter of edicts, was made Secretariat Drafter;
translations.idiomatic: Li Han was appointed Secretariat Drafter;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、都官郎中劉溫叟加知制誥；

translations.literal: Liu Wensou, Hanlin academician and Director of the Capital Crimes Bureau, was additionally made drafter of edicts;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wensou was additionally made drafter of edicts;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、主客員外郎範質改比部郎中、知制誥，並依舊充職；

translations.literal: Fan Zhi, Hanlin academician and Vice Director of the Foreign Guests Bureau, was changed to Director of the Comparison Bureau and made drafter of edicts, continuing in his former duties;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhi was transferred to the Comparison Bureau, made drafter of edicts, and kept his existing duties;

sentences.zh: 祠部員外郎、知制誥張沆本官充學士；

translations.literal: Zhang Hong, Vice Director of the Sacrificial Affairs Bureau and drafter of edicts, was appointed academician in his existing office;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hong was appointed Hanlin academician while retaining his existing posts;

sentences.zh: 以太常少卿陶穀為中書舍人。

translations.literal: Tao Gu, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Gu was appointed Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·陶穀傳》：穀性急率，嘗與兗帥安審信集會，杯酒相失，為審信所奏，時方姑息武臣，穀坐責授太常少卿。

translations.literal: (Biography of Tao Gu, History of Song: Gu was by nature impetuous and blunt. Once at a gathering with Yan's military commissioner An Shenxin, wine led to a breach; Shenxin memorialized against him. The court was then indulgent toward military men, and Gu was punished and made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Tao Gu: Impetuous by nature, he once quarreled over wine with Yan commander An Shenxin, who memorialized against him; as the court was then indulgent toward generals, Gu was demoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 嘗上言：「頃蒞西臺，每見臺司詳斷刑獄，少有即時決者。

translations.literal: He once memorialized: "When I recently served at the Western Terrace, I saw the censorate review criminal cases in detail, yet few were decided on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: He once submitted: "When I lately served on the Western Censorate, I saw case after case reviewed in detail, yet few decided at once.

sentences.zh: 至於閭閻夫婦，小有爭訟，淹滯即時；

translations.literal: As for common couples in the lanes, even small disputes were held up without immediate resolution;
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary neighborhood disputes, however small, were delayed without prompt settlement;

sentences.zh: 坊市死亡喪葬，必候臺司判狀；

translations.literal: deaths and burials in the wards and markets had to await a written ruling from the censorate;
translations.idiomatic: burials in the wards and markets required a censorate writ;

sentences.zh: 奴婢病亡，亦須檢驗。

translations.literal: when slaves or maidservants died of illness, examination was also required.
translations.idiomatic: even the death of a sick slave or maid required inspection.

sentences.zh: 吏因緣為奸，而邀求不已，經旬不獲埋瘞。

translations.literal: Clerks used the opportunity for corruption and made endless demands, so that for ten days burial could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks exploited the rules for graft and endless demands, so bodies might lie unburied for ten days.

sentences.zh: 望申條約，以革其弊。

translations.literal: I hope regulations may be set forth to reform these abuses."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that clear rules be issued to end these abuses."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 俄拜中書舍人。）〉

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed Secretariat Drafter.))
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed Secretariat Drafter.))

sentences.zh: 己亥，以邠州節度使劉景巖為陜州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Liu Jingyan, Military Commissioner of Bin Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liu Jingyan was transferred from Bin to Shaan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，新授恒州節度使馬全節卒，輟朝，贈中書令。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Ma Quanjie, newly appointed Military Commissioner of Heng Prefecture, died; court was suspended, and he was posthumously awarded Grand Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Ma Quanjie died shortly after his appointment to Heng; court mourning was observed, and he was posthumously made Grand Counselor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大理卿張仁願卒，贈秘書監。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Zhang Renyuan, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, died and was posthumously made Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhang Renyuan, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, died and was posthumously made Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 遣刑部尚書竇貞固等分詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Justice, and others were dispatched separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Justice, and others were sent to temples and monasteries throughout the realm to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以定州節度使王周為恒州節度使，以前易州刺史安審約為定州留後。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Wang Zhou, Military Commissioner of Ding Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Heng Prefecture; An Shenyue, former Prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made acting commander of Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wang Zhou was moved from Ding to Heng, and An Shenyue was left in charge at Ding.

sentences.zh: 是月，兩京及州郡十五並奏旱。

translations.literal: That month, both capitals and fifteen prefectures all reported drought.
translations.idiomatic: That month, both capitals and fifteen prefectures reported drought.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未朔，以侍衛步軍都指揮使、領夔州節度使田武為昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day, the day yiwei, Tian Wu, Commander of the Palace Infantry and holder of Kui Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month (yiwei), Tian Wu, commander of the palace infantry who also held Kui, was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，左諫議大夫李元龜奏，請禁止天下僧尼典買院舍，從之。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Li Yuangui, Left Remonstrance Counselor, memorialized asking that monks and nuns throughout the realm be forbidden to buy and sell monastic compounds; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Li Yuangui memorialized to forbid monks and nuns empire-wide from buying or selling monastic property; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，前少府監李楷貶坊州司戶，坐冒請逃死吏人衣糧入己故也。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Li Kai, former Director of the Palace Workshops, was demoted to Registrar of Fang Prefecture for having falsely claimed clothing and grain rations for deserters and dead clerks for his own use.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, former Director of the Palace Workshops Li Kai was demoted to registrar of Fang Prefecture for embezzling rations issued for deserters and deceased clerks.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前齊州防禦使薛可言為延州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Xue Keyan, former Defense Commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was made acting commander of Yan Prefecture's military forces.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xue Keyan, former defense commissioner of Qi, was left in charge of Yan's forces.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day, the day jiazi, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month (jiazi), the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人陶穀奏，請權廢太常寺二舞郎。

translations.literal: Tao Gu, Secretariat Drafter, memorialized asking that the two dance officers of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices be provisionally abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Drafter Tao Gu asked that the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' two dance officers be suspended for the time being.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宰臣和凝罷相，守右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the chief minister He Ning was removed as chancellor and retained as Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, chief minister He Ning left the chancellorship and remained as Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以樞密使馮玉為中書侍郎、平章事，使如故。

translations.literal: Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Counselor; his commission remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Counselor while retaining his post at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔：「諸御史今後除準式請假外，不得以細故小事請假離京；

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict stated: "Henceforth, except for leave according to regulation, censors may not request leave from the capital on petty grounds;
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, an edict declared: "Henceforth censors may leave the capital only on regulated leave, not on petty pretexts;

sentences.zh: 除奉制命差推事及按察外，不得以諸雜細務差出。

translations.literal: except when sent out on imperial commission to investigate or inspect, they may not be dispatched on various miscellaneous minor duties."
translations.idiomatic: nor be sent out on miscellaneous duties except when commissioned by edict to investigate or inspect."

sentences.zh: 」丙子，以靈州節度使馮暉為邠州節度使，加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Feng Hui, Military Commissioner of Ling Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Bin Prefecture and given the additional title of Acting Grand Preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Feng Hui was transferred from Ling to Bin and made Acting Grand Preceptor;

sentences.zh: 以前鄜州節度使丁審琪為左羽林統軍；

translations.literal: Ding Shenqi, former Military Commissioner of Fu Prefecture, was made Commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army;
translations.idiomatic: Ding Shenqi, former commissioner of Fu, was made commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army;

sentences.zh: 以前鄜州節度使郭謹為左神武統軍。

translations.literal: Guo Jin, former Military Commissioner of Fu Prefecture, was made Commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Jin, also formerly of Fu, was made commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 西京留司御史臺奏：「新授鄧州節度使宋彥筠於銀沙灘斬廳頭鄭溫。

translations.literal: The Western Capital's acting censorate reported: "Song Yanyun, newly appointed Military Commissioner of Deng Prefecture, executed his bureau chief Zheng Wen at Silver Sand Beach."
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital censorate reported that Song Yanyun, newly appointed to Deng, had executed his bureau chief Zheng Wen at Silver Sand Beach.

sentences.zh: 」詔鞫之，款云：「彥筠出身軍旅，不知事體，不合專擅行法。

translations.literal: An edict ordered an inquiry; the confession stated: "Yanyun rose from the military and did not understand proper procedure; he should not have exercised the law on his own authority."
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered an inquiry; the confession read: "Yanyun came up through the army and did not understand proper forms; he had no right to execute justice on his own."

sentences.zh: 」詔釋其罪。

translations.literal: An edict released him from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 以工部尚書王松權知貢舉。

translations.literal: Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made acting supervisor of the examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Song, Minister of Works, was appointed acting supervisor of the civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前晉州節度使安叔千為右金吾上將軍；

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, An Shuqian, former Military Commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was made General-in-Chief of the Right Imperial Guards;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, An Shuqian, formerly of Jin, was made General-in-Chief of the Right Imperial Guards;

sentences.zh: 以三司副使、給事中李穀為磁州刺史，充北面水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: Li Gu, Vice Commissioner of the Three Departments and Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made Prefect of Ci Prefecture and appointed Commissioner for Northern Land and Water Transport.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu was made prefect of Ci and commissioner for northern land and water transport.

sentences.zh: 分遣使臣於諸道率馬。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched separately to the various circuits to gather horses.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to the circuits to requisition horses.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以左金吾上將軍皇甫立為左衛上將軍，以右羽林統軍李懷忠為左武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Huangfu Li, General-in-Chief of the Left Imperial Guards, was made General-in-Chief of the Left Guards; Li Huaizhong, Commander of the Right Forest of Feathers Army, was made General-in-Chief of the Left Martial Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Huangfu Li became General-in-Chief of the Left Guards, and Li Huaizhong General-in-Chief of the Left Martial Guards.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，新授潞州節度使田武卒，輟朝，贈太尉。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Tian Wu, newly appointed Military Commissioner of Lu Prefecture, died; court was suspended, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Tian Wu died shortly after his appointment to Lu; court mourning was observed, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，湖南奏，靜江軍節度使馬希杲卒。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Hunan reported that Ma Xigao, Military Commissioner of the Jingjiang Army, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Hunan reported the death of Jingjiang commander Ma Xigao.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，以西京留守、北面馬步軍都排陣使景延廣為北面行營副招討使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingshen, Jing Yanguang, defender of the Western Capital and overall array-master of the northern horse and foot forces, was made Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Northern Campaign Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the ninth month, Jing Yanguang, defender of the Western Capital and northern array-master, was made deputy commander-in-chief of the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以刑部侍郎趙遠為戶部侍郎，以工部侍郎李式為刑部侍郎，以中書舍人盧價為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Zhao Yuan, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Li Shi, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Justice; Lu Jia, Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zhao Yuan moved to Revenue, Li Shi to Justice, and Secretariat Drafter Lu Jia to Works.

sentences.zh: 價久次綸闈，舊例合轉禮部侍郎或御史中丞，宰臣馮玉擬此官，桑維翰以為資望淺，不署狀。

translations.literal: Jia had long served in the drafting office; by precedent he should have been transferred to Vice Minister of Rites or Censor-in-Chief. Chancellor Feng Yu proposed this post, but Sang Weihan considered his standing too slight and would not sign the document.
translations.idiomatic: Jia had long served in the drafting office and by precedent should have risen to Vice Minister of Rites or Censor-in-Chief; Feng Yu proposed the Works post, but Sang Weihan judged his standing too slight and refused to sign.

sentences.zh: 無何，維翰休沐數日，玉獨奏行之，維翰由是不樂，與玉有間矣。

translations.literal: Before long, while Weihan was on leave for several days, Yu memorialized alone and had it carried out; Weihan was therefore displeased, and a rift opened between him and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, while Weihan was on leave, Yu had the appointment carried through on his own; Weihan took offense, and a breach opened between the two.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸繁臺觀馬，遂幸李守貞第。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the emperor visited Fanta Terrace to watch horses, then visited the residence of Li Shouzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the emperor watched horses at Fanta Terrace, then called at Li Shouzhen's house.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以晉州節度使張從恩為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Zhang Cong'en, Military Commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Cong'en was transferred from Jin to Lu.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎張昭遠加階爵，酬修《唐史》之勞也。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was advanced in rank and enfeoffment in reward for compiling the History of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, received a promotion in rank and title as reward for compiling the History of Tang.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·張昭遠傳》：加金紫階，進爵邑。）〉

translations.literal: (Biography of Zhang Zhaoyuan, History of Song: He was advanced to the gold-and-purple rank and promoted in title and fief.))
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Zhang Zhaoyuan: He was advanced to the gold-and-purple rank and given a higher title and fief.))

sentences.zh: 戊申，升曹州為節鎮，以威信軍為軍額。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Cao Prefecture was raised to a military commission, with Weixin Army as the army designation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Cao was elevated to a full military commission under the name Weixin Army.

sentences.zh: 詔李守貞率兵屯澶州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Shouzhen to lead troops and encamp at Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen was ordered to encamp at Chan with his troops.

sentences.zh: 己酉，月掩昴宿。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the moon concealed the Mao constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the moon occulted the Mao asterism.

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使焦繼勛為宣徽南院使，以內客省使孟承誨為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Commissioner of the Southern Bureau; Meng Chenghui, Commissioner of the Inner Guests Office, was made Commissioner of the Northern Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao Jixun moved from the northern to the southern palace secretariat bureau, and Meng Chenghui took the northern post.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以前太子詹事王居敏為鴻臚卿，李專美為大理卿，以太子賓客致仕馬裔孫為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Wang Jumin, former Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Director of the Court of State Ceremonial; Li Zhuanmei was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review; Ma Yisun, retired Palace Companion to the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wang Jumin became Director of the Court of State Ceremonial, Li Zhuanmei Director of Judicial Review, and the retired palace companion Ma Yisun Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，移泰州理所於滿城縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the seat of government of Tai Prefecture was moved to Mancheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Tai Prefecture's administrative seat was moved to Mancheng County.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔相州節度使張彥澤率兵屯恒州。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, an edict ordered Zhang Yanzhe, Military Commissioner of Xiang Prefecture, to lead troops and encamp at Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Zhang Yanzhe of Xiang was ordered to encamp at Heng with his troops.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，以河陽節度使何建為涇州節度使，以許州節度使李從溫為河陽節度使，以前鄭州節度使石赟為曹州節度使。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day wuyin, He Jian, Military Commissioner of Heyang, was made Military Commissioner of Jing Prefecture; Li Congwen, Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Heyang; Shi Yun, former Military Commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the tenth month, He Jian was sent to Jing, Li Congwen to Heyang, and Shi Yun, formerly of Zheng, to Cao.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣使太子賓客羅周嶽、使副太子右庶子王延濟冊兩浙節度使錢宏佐為守太尉。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the envoy Luo Zhouyue, Palace Companion to the Heir Apparent, and the deputy envoy Wang Yanji, Right Vice Mentor of the Heir Apparent, were dispatched to invest Qian Hongzuo, Military Commissioner of the Two Zhes, as Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Luo Zhouyue and his deputy Wang Yanji were sent to invest Qian Hongzuo of the Two Zhes as Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，右金吾衛上將軍楊彥詢卒，贈太子太師。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Yang Yanxun, General-in-Chief of the Right Imperial Guards, died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yang Yanxun died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，高麗遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以前延州節度使王令溫為靈州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Wang Lingwen, former Military Commissioner of Yan Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wang Lingwen was appointed from Yan to Ling.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以邢州兵馬留後劉在明為晉州兵馬留後，以前河陽留後方太為邢州留後。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Liu Zaiming, acting commander of Xing Prefecture's military forces, was made acting commander of Jin Prefecture's military forces; Fang Tai, former acting commander of Heyang, was made acting commander of Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Liu Zaiming was left in charge at Jin, and Fang Tai at Xing.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，升陳州為節鎮，以鎮安軍為軍額。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Chen Prefecture was raised to a military commission, with Zhen'an Army as the army designation.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Chen was elevated to a full military commission under the name Zhen'an Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，以邠州節度使馮暉兼侍衛步軍都指揮使，充北面行營先鋒馬步軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuxu, Feng Hui, Military Commissioner of Bin Prefecture, was additionally made Commander of the Palace Foot Guard, and was made Commander of the Vanguard Horse-and-Foot Army of the Northern Expeditionary Camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, Feng Hui, Military Commissioner of Bin Prefecture, was also appointed Commander of the Palace Foot Guard and placed in command of the vanguard horse-and-foot forces of the northern expeditionary army.

sentences.zh: 以權知高麗國事王武為檢校太保、使持節、玄菟州都督，充大義軍使，封高麗國王。

translations.literal: Wang Wu, who held acting authority over Goryeo state affairs, was made Acting Grand Mentor, Commissioner with Staff of Authority, Governor of Xuantu Commandery, and Grand Envoy of the Dayi Army, and was enfeoffed as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wu, who was acting administrator of Goryeo affairs, was appointed Acting Grand Mentor, given a staff of authority as Commissioner, named Governor of Xuantu Commandery and envoy of the Dayi Army, and enfeoffed as King of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，日南至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the winter solstice arrived; the emperor took the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the winter solstice, the emperor received the New Year congratulations in the Chongyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊申，兩浙奏，順化軍節度使錢鐸卒。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the Two Zhe region reported that Qian Duo, Military Commissioner of the Shunhua Army, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Two Zhe circuit reported that Qian Duo, Military Commissioner of the Shunhua Army, had died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以壽州節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使李彥韜為陳州節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Li Yan'ao, Military Commissioner of Shou Prefecture and Commander of the Palace Horse Guard, was made Military Commissioner of Chen Prefecture, retaining command of the army as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Li Yan'ao, Military Commissioner of Shou and Commander of the Palace Horse Guard, was appointed Military Commissioner of Chen Prefecture while retaining his military command.

sentences.zh: 丙申，前商州刺史李俊除名，坐受財枉法也。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the former Shangzhou Prefect Li Jun was stripped of his name, for the crime of taking bribes and perverting the law.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the former prefect of Shangzhou, Li Jun, was expelled from office and stripped of rank for accepting bribes and perverting justice.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，以兩浙節度使、吳越國王錢宏佐兼東南面兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yichou, Qian Hongzuo, Military Commissioner of the Two Zhe and King of Wuyue, was additionally made Grand Marshal of the Southeast Forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yichou, Qian Hongzuo, Military Commissioner of Two Zhe and King of Wuyue, was also appointed Grand Marshal of southeastern forces.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以吳越國金馬左廂都指揮使、湖州刺史胡思進遙領虔州昭信軍節度使，以吳越國金馬右廂都指揮使、明州刺史闞璠遙領宣州寧國軍節度使，並典軍如故。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Hu Sijin, Commander of the Left Wing of the Wuyue Kingdom's Golden Horse Guard and Prefect of Huzhou, was given the distant title of Military Commissioner of Qianzhou's Zhaoxin Army; and Kan Fan, Commander of the Right Wing and Prefect of Ming, was given the distant title of Military Commissioner of Xuanzhou's Ningguo Army — both retaining command of the army as before.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Hu Sijin, commander of the Wuyue Golden Horse Guard's left wing and prefect of Huzhou, was given the honorary title of Military Commissioner of Qianzhou's Zhaoxin Army, and Kan Fan, commander of the right wing and prefect of Ming, was given the honorary title of Military Commissioner of Xuanzhou's Ningguo Army; both retained their existing commands.

sentences.zh: 左羽林統軍丁審琪卒，贈太尉。

translations.literal: Ding Shenqi, Commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, died; he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Shenqi, commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, died and was posthumously promoted to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以工部侍郎盧價為禮部侍郎，以右散騎常侍、集賢殿學士、判院事司徒詡為工部侍郎，依前充職；

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Rites; and Situxun, Right Regular Attendant of Cavalry, Academician of the Jixian Hall, and judge of academy affairs, was made Vice Minister of Works, retaining his former posts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Works, was appointed Vice Minister of Rites, and Situxun, Right Regular Attendant, Jixian Hall academician, and judge of academy affairs, was appointed Vice Minister of Works while retaining his other posts.

sentences.zh: 以前中書舍人殷鵬為給事中，充樞密直學士；

translations.literal: The former Mid-Level Secretariat Gentleman Yin Peng was made Supervising Secretariat Gentleman and direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The former Secretariat Gentleman Yin Peng was appointed Supervising Secretariat Gentleman and direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以給事中劉知新為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: The Supervising Secretariat Gentleman Liu Zhixin was made Right Regular Attendant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhixin, Supervising Secretariat Gentleman, was appointed Right Regular Attendant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，陜府節度使劉景巖來朝。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Liu Jingyan, Military Commissioner of Shan Prefecture, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Liu Jingyan, Military Commissioner of Shan Prefecture, came to court.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，狩於近郊，獵也。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, he hunted in the near suburbs — a hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the emperor went hunting in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，光祿卿致仕陳元卒於太原。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Chen Yuan, retired Grand Master of Splendor, died at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Chen Yuan, retired Grand Master of Splendor, died at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命使冊高麗國王王武。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, envoys were ordered to invest King Wu of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the emperor dispatched envoys to invest Wang Wu as King of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以前兗州節度使安審信為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the former Yanzhou Military Commissioner An Shenxin was made Military Commissioner of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the former Military Commissioner of Yan, An Shenxin, was appointed Military Commissioner of Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以樞密使、中書令桑維翰為開封尹；

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Sang Weihan, Bureau Commissioner and Director of the Secretariat, was made Acting Mayor of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Sang Weihan, Bureau Commissioner and Director of the Secretariat, was appointed Acting Mayor of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 以司空、門下侍郎、平章事劉句判三司；

translations.literal: Liu Gou, Minister of Works without portfolio, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Councilor, was placed in charge of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Gou, Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Councilor, was placed in charge of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 以左僕射、門下侍郎、平章事李崧為守侍中，充樞密使；

translations.literal: Li Song, Minister of the Left, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Councilor, was made Acting Palace Director and Bureau Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Song, Minister of the Left, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Councilor, was appointed Acting Palace Director and Bureau Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以開封尹趙瑩為中書令、宏文館大學士；

translations.literal: Zhao Ying, Acting Mayor of Kaifeng, was made Director of the Secretariat and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ying, Acting Mayor of Kaifeng, was appointed Director of the Secretariat and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 以宣徽南院使焦繼勛知陜州軍州事。

translations.literal: Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Imperial Secretariat, was appointed to administer the military and civil affairs of Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Imperial Secretariat, was appointed to administer military and civil affairs in Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·焦繼勛傳》：西人寇邊，朝議發師致討，繼勛抗疏請行，拜秦州觀察使兼諸蕃水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: (History of Song, Biography of Jiao Jixun: When western peoples raided the border, the court deliberated sending troops to punish them; Jixun submitted a memorial resisting and requesting to go, and was appointed Observation Commissioner of Qin Prefecture and concurrently Commissioner for Transport of Land and Water Routes among the various barbarian tribes.)
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Jiao Jixun: When western tribes raided the frontier, the court debated dispatching an expedition; Jixun submitted a memorial insisting on going himself and was appointed Observation Commissioner of Qin and concurrent commissioner for land and water transport among the frontier tribes.)

sentences.zh: 既至，推恩信，設方略，招誘諸部，相率奉玉帛牛酒乞盟，邊境以安。

translations.literal: Once he arrived, he extended grace and trust, devised stratagems, and enticed the various tribes; they successively came bearing jade silks, cattle, and wine to request alliance, and the border was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he won trust through generosity, laid out a strategy, and drew the tribes in; they came in succession offering jade, silk, cattle, and wine to sue for peace, and the frontier was settled.

sentences.zh: 俄徙知陜州。）〉

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to administer Shan Prefecture.)
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to administer Shan Prefecture.)

sentences.zh: 己丑，邠州節度使馮暉準詔來朝。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Feng Hui, Military Commissioner of Bin Prefecture, came to court in obedience to the edict.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Feng Hui, Military Commissioner of Bin, came to court as ordered.

sentences.zh: 是歲，帝每遇四方進獻器皿，多以銀於外府易金而入，謂左右曰：「金者貴而且輕，便於人力。

translations.literal: That year, whenever the emperor encountered vessels presented as tribute from the four directions, he often exchanged silver at outer treasuries for gold to bring in, saying to those around him: "Gold is precious and moreover light — convenient for human labor.
translations.idiomatic: That year, whenever tribute vessels arrived from the provinces, the emperor often had silver exchanged for gold at outer treasuries and brought the gold in, telling his attendants, "Gold is precious yet light — easier for men to carry.

sentences.zh: 」識者以為北遷之兆也。

translations.literal: " Those who understood took this as an omen of moving north.
translations.idiomatic: " Observers took this as an omen of the court's removal to the north.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·劉濤傳》：少帝奢侈，常以銀易金，廣其器皿。

translations.literal: (History of Song, Biography of Liu Tao: The young emperor was extravagant, often exchanging silver for gold to enlarge his vessels.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Liu Tao: The young emperor was extravagant and often exchanged silver for gold to enlarge his tableware.

sentences.zh: 李崧判三司，令上庫金之數。

translations.literal: Li Song, who oversaw the Three Departments, ordered a count of the gold in the upper treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Li Song, who oversaw the Three Departments, ordered an inventory of gold in the upper treasury.

sentences.zh: 及崧以原簿校之，少數千鎰。

translations.literal: When Song checked against the original ledger, several thousand yi were short.
translations.idiomatic: When Song checked the books, several thousand yi were missing.

sentences.zh: 崧責曰：「帑庫通式，一日不受虛數，毫厘則有重典。

translations.literal: Song rebuked him, saying: "Treasury regulations — not one day may they accept a false number; a hair's breadth brings severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Song rebuked him: "Treasury rules forbid false entries even for a single day; the slightest discrepancy brings severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 」濤曰：「帑司常有報不盡數，以備宣索。

translations.literal: " Tao said: "The treasury office often does not report the full count, to prepare for imperial requisitions.
translations.idiomatic: " Tao replied, "The treasury often underreports its holdings to reserve stock for imperial requisitions.

sentences.zh: 」崧令有司劾濤，濤事迫，以情告樞密使桑維翰，乃止罰一月俸。）〉

translations.literal: " Song had the officials impeach Tao; pressed by the affair, Tao told the Bureau Commissioner Sang Weihan the full story, and he was only fined one month's salary.)
translations.idiomatic: " Song had the officials impeach Tao; cornered, Tao confessed to Bureau Commissioner Sang Weihan, and the penalty was reduced to forfeiture of one month's salary.)

sentences.zh: 開運三年春正月癸巳朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year of Kaiyun, on the first day of the first month, the day guisi, new year's day; the emperor took the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and escorts performed according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year of Kaiyun, on guisi, the first day of the first month, the emperor received New Year congratulations in the Chongyuan Hall with the full guard array.

sentences.zh: 詔改鑄天下合同印、書詔印、御前印，並以黃金為之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered recasting the empire's Contract Seals, Proclamation Seals, and Imperial Seals, all to be made of yellow gold.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the empire's contract seals, proclamation seals, and imperial seals recast in yellow gold.

sentences.zh: 己亥，貝州梁漢璋奏，蕃寇屯聚，將謀入寇。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Liang Hanzhang of Beizhou reported that barbarian raiders had massed and were plotting invasion.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liang Hanzhang of Bei Prefecture reported that barbarian forces had gathered and were preparing to invade.

sentences.zh: 詔符彥卿屯荊州口。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fu Yanqing to encamp at Jingzhou Ford.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Fu Yanqing to encamp at Jingzhou Ford.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·符彥卿傳》：再出河朔，彥卿不與，易其行伍，配以羸師數千戍荊州口。）〉

translations.literal: (History of Song, Biography of Fu Yanqing: When dispatched again to Hebei, Yanqing would not go; they changed his formation and paired him with several thousand weak troops to garrison Jingzhou Ford.)
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Fu Yanqing: When he was ordered out to Hebei again, Yanqing refused; the court reshuffled his command and sent him to garrison Jingzhou Ford with only a few thousand weak troops.)

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前華州節度使劉繼勛為同州節度使，以陜州節度使劉景巖為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the former Hua Prefecture Military Commissioner Liu Jixun was made Military Commissioner of Tong Prefecture; and Liu Jingyan, Military Commissioner of Shan Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the former Military Commissioner of Hua, Liu Jixun, was appointed Military Commissioner of Tong, and Liu Jingyan of Shan was appointed Military Commissioner of Deng.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以宣徽南院使、知陜州事焦繼勛為陜州留後。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau and administrator of Shan Prefecture, was made provisional authority over Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau and administrator of Shan, was appointed provisional military commissioner of Shan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，刑部員外王洧賜自家自盡，坐私用宮錢經營求利故也。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Wang Si, Vice Minister of Punishments, was granted permission to take his own life at home, for the crime of privately using palace funds to seek profit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Wang Si, Vice Minister of Punishments, was permitted to commit suicide at home for misappropriating palace funds for private gain.

sentences.zh: 右司郎中李知損貶均州司戶，員外置，馳驛發遣，坐前任度支判官日與解縣榷鹽使王景遇交遊借貸故也。

translations.literal: Li Zhisun, Director of the Right Office, was demoted to Registrar of Jun Prefecture, an extra-office appointment, and dispatched by rapid relay, for during his tenure as revenue-section judge he had exchanged loans and visits with Wang Jingyu, commissioner of the Jie Prefecture salt monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhisun, Director of the Right Office, was demoted to registrar of Jun Prefecture on an extra-office basis and sent off by rapid relay for borrowing money and socializing with Wang Jingyu, salt monopoly commissioner of Jie County, while serving as a revenue-section judge.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔侍衛親軍副都指揮使李守貞率師巡撫北邊。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, an edict ordered Li Shouzhen, Deputy Commander of the Palace Personal Guard, to lead troops in inspecting and pacifying the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, an edict ordered Li Shouzhen, Deputy Commander of the Palace Personal Guard, to lead troops on an inspection tour of the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以皇弟秦州節度使重睿為許州節度使，以許州節度使安審琦為兗州節度使，以兗州節度使趙在禮為晉昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the emperor's younger brother Chongrui, Military Commissioner of Qin Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture; An Shenqi, Military Commissioner of Xu, was made Military Commissioner of Yan Prefecture; and Zhao Zaili, Military Commissioner of Yan, was made Military Commissioner of the Jinchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the emperor's younger brother Chongrui, Military Commissioner of Qin, was appointed Military Commissioner of Xu; An Shenqi of Xu was transferred to Yan; and Zhao Zaili of Yan was appointed Military Commissioner of the Jinchang Army.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以涇州節度使何建為秦州節度使，以前貝州節度使史威為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, He Jian, Military Commissioner of Jing Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Qin Prefecture; and the former Beizhou Military Commissioner Shi Wei was made Military Commissioner of Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, He Jian, Military Commissioner of Jing, was appointed Military Commissioner of Qin, and the former Military Commissioner of Bei, Shi Wei, was appointed Military Commissioner of Jing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，定州奏，契丹入寇。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Ding Prefecture reported that the Khitan had invaded.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Ding Prefecture reported a Khitan invasion.

sentences.zh: 己未，二王後守太僕少卿、襲酅國公楊延壽除名配流威州，終身勿齒。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Yang Yanshou, guardian of the two former lineages as Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud and hereditary Duke of Xi, was stripped of his name and banished to Wei Prefecture, never to be ranked for life.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Yang Yanshou, a descendant of the two former dynasties serving as Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud and hereditary Duke of Xi, was stripped of rank and exiled to Wei Prefecture, barred from office for life.

sentences.zh: 延壽奉命於磁州檢苗，受贓二百餘匹，準律當絞，有司以二王後入議，故貸其死。

translations.literal: Yanshou had been ordered to inspect seedling tax at Cizhou and accepted bribes of over two hundred bolts; by law he deserved strangulation; the officials debated his descent from the two former lineages and so spared his death.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshou had been sent to Cizhou to inspect the seedling tax and accepted more than two hundred bolts of cloth in bribes; by law he merited execution, but because he was a descendant of the two former dynasties the authorities commuted the death sentence.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，以權知河西節度使張遵古為河西留後。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renchen, new year's day, Zhang Zungu, acting Military Commissioner of Hexi, was made provisional authority over Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, the first day of the month, Zhang Zungu, acting Military Commissioner of Hexi, was appointed provisional military commissioner of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以御史中丞顏衎為戶部侍郎，以戶部侍郎趙遠為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Yan Yan, Chief Imperial Censor, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; and Zhao Yuan, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Chief Imperial Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Yan Yan, Chief Imperial Censor, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue, and Zhao Yuan, Vice Minister of Revenue, was appointed Chief Imperial Censor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以邠州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使馮暉為河陽節度使，以前涇州節度使李德充為邠州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Feng Hui, Military Commissioner of Bin and Commander of the Palace Foot Guard, was made Military Commissioner of Heyang; and the former Jing Prefecture Military Commissioner Li Dechong was made Military Commissioner of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Feng Hui, Military Commissioner of Bin and Commander of the Palace Foot Guard, was appointed Military Commissioner of Heyang, and the former Military Commissioner of Jing, Li Dechong, was appointed Military Commissioner of Bin.

sentences.zh: 李守貞奏，大軍至衡水。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen reported that the great army had reached Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen reported that the main force had reached Hengshui.

sentences.zh: 己亥，奏獲鄭州刺史趙思恭。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, he reported capturing Zhao Sigong, Prefect of Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, he reported the capture of Zhao Sigong, prefect of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，奏大軍回至冀州。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, he reported that the great army had returned to Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, he reported that the main force had withdrawn to Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎顏衎上表，以母老乞解官就養。

translations.literal: Yan Yan, Vice Minister of Revenue, submitted a memorial, citing his aged mother in requesting to resign office and go to serve her.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Yan, Vice Minister of Revenue, submitted a memorial asking to resign and care for his elderly mother.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以皇子齊州防禦使延煦為澶州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the prince Yanxu, Defender of Qi Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the prince Yanxu, Defender of Qi, was appointed Military Commissioner of Chan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，密州上言，饑民殍者一千五百。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Mizhou reported one thousand five hundred starved corpses among the famine-stricken populace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Mizhou reported that fifteen hundred famine victims had died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以瓜州刺史曹元忠為沙州留後。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Cao Yuanzhong, Prefect of Guazhou, was made provisional authority over Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Cao Yuanzhong, prefect of Guazhou, was appointed provisional military commissioner of Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉朔，李守貞自北班師到闕。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day xinyou, new year's day, Li Shouzhen returned from the northern campaign and arrived at court.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinyou, the first day of the month, Li Shouzhen returned from the northern campaign and arrived at court.

sentences.zh: 太原奏，吐渾白可久奔歸契丹，諸侯咸有異志。

translations.literal: Taiyuan reported that the Toghuz Turk Bai Kejiu had fled back to the Khitan, and the various lords all harbored divergent intentions.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan reported that the Toghuz chieftain Bai Kejiu had defected to the Khitan and that regional commanders were showing signs of disloyalty.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宰臣詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the chief ministers went to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the chief ministers went to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 曹州奏，部民相次饑死凡三千人。

translations.literal: Caozhou reported that among the populace of the prefecture three thousand people had successively starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: Caozhou reported that three thousand people in the prefecture had died of starvation in succession.

sentences.zh: 時河南、河北大饑，殍名甚眾，沂、密、兗、鄆寇盜群起，所在屯聚，剽劫縣邑，吏不能禁。

translations.literal: At that time great famine afflicted Henan and Hebei; corpses were very numerous; in Yi, Mi, Yan, and Yun bandit gangs arose everywhere, massing to plunder counties and towns — officials could not suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Henan and Hebei were stricken by severe famine and corpses lay everywhere; in Yi, Mi, Yan, and Yun bandit bands rose up, gathering to raid counties and towns, and local officials could not stop them.

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使安審琦出兵捕逐，為賊所敗。

translations.literal: An Shenqi, Military Commissioner of Yan Prefecture, led troops to pursue and capture them, and was defeated by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi, Military Commissioner of Yan, led troops to pursue the bandits and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸相國寺禱雨。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the emperor visited the Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the emperor visited the Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 皇子延煦與晉昌軍節度使趙在禮結婚，命宗正卿石光贊主之。

translations.literal: The prince Yanxu and Zhao Zaili, Military Commissioner of the Jinchang Army, contracted a marriage; the Director of the Imperial Clan Shi Guangzan was ordered to preside.
translations.idiomatic: The prince Yanxu married the daughter of Zhao Zaili, Military Commissioner of the Jinchang Army, with Shi Guangzan, Director of the Imperial Clan, presiding over the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔，以兵部郎中劉皞為太府卿。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengyin, new year's day, Liu Hao, Director of the Ministry of War, was made Director of the Grand Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin, the first day of the month, Liu Hao, Director of the Ministry of War, was appointed Director of the Grand Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以前同州節度使馮道為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the former Tong Prefecture Military Commissioner Feng Dao was made Military Commissioner of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the former Military Commissioner of Tong, Feng Dao, was appointed Military Commissioner of Deng.

sentences.zh: 定州奏，部民相次擄殺流移，約五千餘戶。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that among the populace of the prefecture people had successively been abducted, slain, and displaced — about five thousand-plus households.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Prefecture reported that more than five thousand households had been abducted, killed, or driven from their homes.

sentences.zh: 青州奏，全家殍死者一百一十二戶。

translations.literal: Qingzhou reported one hundred twelve households in which the entire family had starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou reported one hundred twelve households wiped out by starvation.

sentences.zh: 沂州奏，淮南遣海州刺史領兵一千五百人，應接賊頭常知及。

translations.literal: Yizhou reported that Huainan had sent the Haizhou Prefect leading one thousand five hundred troops to link with the bandit chief Chang Zhiji.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou reported that Huainan had dispatched the prefect of Haizhou with fifteen hundred troops to support the bandit leader Chang Zhiji.

sentences.zh: 詔兗州安審琦領兵捕逐。

translations.literal: An edict ordered An Shenqi of Yan Prefecture to lead troops in pursuit and capture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered An Shenqi of Yan to lead troops against the bandits.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以前太子賓客韋勛為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the former Crown Prince Mentor Wei Xun was made Crown Prince Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the former Crown Prince Mentor Wei Xun was reappointed Crown Prince Mentor.

sentences.zh: 兗州安審琦奏，淮賊抽退，賊頭常知及與相次首領武約等並乞歸命。

translations.literal: An Shenqi of Yan Prefecture reported that the Huainan bandits had withdrawn; the bandit chief Chang Zhiji and successive leaders such as Wu Yue all requested to submit.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi of Yan reported that the Huainan raiders had withdrawn and that the bandit chief Chang Zhiji and successive leaders including Wu Yue had all offered to surrender.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幸大年莊，遊船習射。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the emperor visited Danian Village for a boat tour and archery practice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the emperor visited Danian Village for boating and archery practice.

sentences.zh: 帝醉甚，賜群官器帛過差，夜分方歸內。

translations.literal: The emperor was very drunk; he bestowed vessels and silks on the assembled officials far in excess; only at midnight did he return within.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was deeply drunk, lavished excessive gifts of vessels and silk on his officials, and did not return to the palace until midnight.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以鄜州留後李殷為定州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Li Yin, provisional authority over Yun Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Li Yin, provisional military commissioner of Yun, was appointed Military Commissioner of Ding.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔皇甫遇為北面行營都部署，張彥澤為副，李殷為都監，領兵赴易、定等州，尋止其行。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, an edict made Huangfu Yu overall commander of the Northern Expeditionary Camp, Zhang Yanze deputy, and Li Yin supervisor of troops, leading armies to Yi, Ding, and other prefectures; soon their march was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, an edict appointed Huangfu Yu overall commander of the northern expeditionary army, Zhang Yanze as his deputy, and Li Yin as troop supervisor to lead forces to Yi, Ding, and other prefectures; the march was soon halted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以貝州留後梁漢璋為貝州節度使，以左神武統軍郭謹為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Liang Hanzhang, provisional authority over Bei Prefecture, was made Military Commissioner of Bei Prefecture; and Guo Jin, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was made Military Commissioner of Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Liang Hanzhang, provisional military commissioner of Bei, was appointed Military Commissioner of Bei, and Guo Jin, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was appointed Military Commissioner of Yun.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，登州奏，文登縣部內有銅佛像四、瓷佛像十，自地踴出。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, new year's day, Dengzhou reported that within Wendeng County four copper Buddha images and ten porcelain Buddha images had sprung from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, the first day of the month, Dengzhou reported that four copper Buddha images and ten porcelain Buddha images had emerged from the ground in Wendeng County.

sentences.zh: 狼山招收指揮使孫方簡叛，據狼山歸契丹。

translations.literal: Sun Fangjian, Commander of the Langshan recruitment office, rebelled, seized Langshan, and submitted to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Fangjian, commander of the Langshan recruitment office, rebelled, seized Langshan, and defected to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔諸道不得橫薦官僚，如本處幕府有闕，即得奏薦。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, an edict forbade the various circuits from recommending officials across jurisdictions; if a vacancy existed in one's own headquarters staff, one might then memorialize a recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, an edict forbade the circuits from recommending officials outside their own jurisdictions; only vacancies within a circuit's own headquarters staff could be filled by memorial recommendation.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以前昭義軍節度使李從敏為河陽節度使，以河陽節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使馮暉為靈州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the former Zhaoyi Army Military Commissioner Li Congmin was made Military Commissioner of Heyang; and Feng Hui, Military Commissioner of Heyang and Commander of the Palace Foot Guard, was made Military Commissioner of Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the former Military Commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army, Li Congmin, was appointed Military Commissioner of Heyang, and Feng Hui of Heyang, also Commander of the Palace Foot Guard, was appointed Military Commissioner of Ling.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以鄆州節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使高行周為宋州節度使，加兼中書令，充北面行營副都統；

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Gao Xingzhou, Military Commissioner of Yun Prefecture and Commander of the Palace Personal Guard, was made Military Commissioner of Song Prefecture, additionally made Grand Councilor, and made deputy overall commander of the Northern Expeditionary Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Gao Xingzhou, Military Commissioner of Yun and Commander of the Palace Personal Guard, was appointed Military Commissioner of Song, additionally named Grand Councilor, and made deputy overall commander of the northern expeditionary army.

sentences.zh: 以宋州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: As Military Commissioner of Song Prefecture and Commander of the Palace Personal Guard.
translations.idiomatic: As Military Commissioner of Song and Commander of the Palace Personal Guard.

sentences.zh: （案：以下有闕文。）〉

translations.literal: (Note: text missing below.))
translations.idiomatic: (Note: text missing below.))

sentences.zh: 定州奏，蕃寇壓境。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that barbarian raiders were pressing the border.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Prefecture reported that barbarian forces were pressing the frontier.

sentences.zh: 詔李守貞為北面行營都部署，滑州皇甫遇為副，相州張彥澤充馬軍都指揮使，定州李殷充步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Li Shouzhen overall commander of the Northern Expeditionary Camp; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou as deputy; Zhang Yanze of Xiang as horse-army commander; and Li Yin of Ding as foot-army commander.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Li Shouzhen overall commander of the northern expeditionary army, Huangfu Yu of Hua as his deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang as commander of the horse troops, and Li Yin of Ding as commander of the foot troops.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，以禮部尚書王延為刑部尚書，以工部尚書王松為禮部尚書，以太常卿龍敏為工部尚書，以左丞李慎儀為太常卿，以吏部侍郎張昭遠為左丞，以右丞李詳為吏部侍郎，以前義州刺史李玘為右丞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day renchen, Wang Yan, Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Punishments; Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made Minister of Rites; Long Min, Director of the Imperial Sacrifices, was made Minister of Works; Li Shenyi, Left Vice Director, was made Director of the Imperial Sacrifices; Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Left Vice Director; Li Xiang, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of Personnel; and Li Qi, former Prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renchen, Wang Yan, Minister of Rites, was appointed Minister of Punishments; Wang Song, Minister of Works, was appointed Minister of Rites; Long Min, Director of the Imperial Sacrifices, was appointed Minister of Works; Li Shenyi, Left Vice Director, was appointed Director of the Imperial Sacrifices; Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Left Vice Director; Li Xiang, Right Vice Director, was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel; and Li Qi, former prefect of Yi, was appointed Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 前晉昌軍節度使安彥威薨，輟朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: The former Jinchang Army Military Commissioner An Yanwei died; court mourning was suspended; he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: The former Military Commissioner of the Jinchang Army, An Yanwei, died; the court suspended audiences; he was posthumously promoted to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，兩浙節度使、吳越國王錢宏佐加守太師，北京留守、河東節度使、北平王劉知遠加守太尉。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Qian Hongzuo, Military Commissioner of the Two Zhe and King of Wuyue, was additionally made Acting Grand Preceptor; and Liu Zhiyuan, regent of Beijing, Military Commissioner of Hedong, and Duke of Beiping, was additionally made Acting Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Qian Hongzuo, Military Commissioner of Two Zhe and King of Wuyue, was additionally appointed Acting Grand Preceptor, and Liu Zhiyuan, regent of Beijing, Military Commissioner of Hedong, and Duke of Beiping, was additionally appointed Acting Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 滄州奏，蕃寇攻饒安縣。

translations.literal: Cangzhou reported that barbarian raiders were attacking Rao'an County.
translations.idiomatic: Cangzhou reported that barbarian forces were attacking Rao'an County.

sentences.zh: 楊劉口河決西岸，水闊四十里。

translations.literal: The west bank of the Yellow River at Yangliu Ford burst; the water was forty li wide.
translations.idiomatic: The west bank of the Yellow River at Yangliu Ford collapsed, and the flood spread forty li across.

sentences.zh: 以前鄧州節度使劉景巖為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: The former Deng Prefecture Military Commissioner Liu Jingyan was made Crown Prince Grand Preceptor and retired.
translations.idiomatic: The former Military Commissioner of Deng, Liu Jingyan, was appointed Crown Prince Grand Preceptor and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宋州谷熟縣河水雨水一概東流，漂沒秋稼。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, in Gushu County of Song Prefecture, river water and rainwater together flowed eastward and washed away the autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, in Gushu County of Song Prefecture, river water and rain surged east together and drowned the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大理卿李專美卒。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Li Zhuanmei, Director of the Court of Law, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Li Zhuanmei, Director of the Court of Law, died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔偽清泰朝經削奪官爵朱宏昭、馮赟、康義誠、王思同、藥彥稠等，並復其官爵。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, an edict restored the titles and offices that had been stripped from Zhu Hongzhao, Feng Yun, Kang Yicheng, Wang Sitong, Yao Yanchou, and others of the false Qingtai reign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, an edict restored the ranks and offices stripped from Zhu Hongzhao, Feng Yun, Kang Yicheng, Wang Sitong, Yao Yanchou, and others who had served the false Qingtai court.

sentences.zh: 自夏初至是，河南、河北諸州郡餓死者數萬人，群盜蜂起，剽略縣鎮，霖雨不止，川澤泛漲，損害秋稼。

translations.literal: From early summer until now, in the prefectures and districts of Henan and Hebei tens of thousands died of starvation; bandits rose in swarms and plundered counties and towns; incessant rains did not cease; rivers and marshes flooded; and the autumn crops were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: From early summer until now, tens of thousands had starved to death across Henan and Hebei; bandits swarmed and raided counties and towns; unceasing rains flooded rivers and marshes and ruined the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 八月己未朔，以左諫議大夫裴羽為給事中。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, the day jiwu, Pei Yu, Left Remonstrance Censor, was made Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month (jiwu), Pei Yu, Left Remonstrance Censor, was appointed Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，李守貞、皇甫遇駐軍定州。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Li Shouzhen and Huangfu Yu encamped their armies at Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Li Shouzhen and Huangfu Yu encamped their forces at Ding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸南莊，召從臣宴樂，至暮還宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the emperor visited the Southern Villa, summoned attendant ministers for feasting and music, and returned to the palace at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the emperor went to the Southern Villa, summoned his attendant ministers for feasting and music, and returned to the palace at dusk.

sentences.zh: 詔潞州運糧十三萬赴恒州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Lu Prefecture to transport 130,000 [units of] grain to Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Lu Prefecture to ship 130,000 units of grain to Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右散騎常侍張煦為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zhang Xu, Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Prefect of Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhang Xu, Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was appointed Prefect of Qing.

sentences.zh: 李守貞奏，大軍至望都縣，相次至長城北，遇敵千餘騎，轉鬥四十里，斬蕃將解裏相公。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen reported that the main army reached Wangdu County and in succession reached north of the Long Wall; they met more than a thousand enemy horsemen and fought in retreat for forty li, beheading the barbarian general Jieli, styled Prime Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen reported that the main army reached Wangdu and then the north side of the Long Wall, where it met more than a thousand enemy horsemen; after fighting in retreat for forty li, it beheaded the Khitan general Jieli, styled Prime Minister.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔班師。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict ordered withdrawal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, an edict ordered the army to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前亳州防禦使邊蔚為戶部侍郎；

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Bian Wei, former Defense Commissioner of Bo Prefecture, was made Vice Minister of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Bian Wei, former Defense Commissioner of Bo, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue;

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎李式為戶部侍郎，充三司副使；

translations.literal: Li Shi, Vice Minister of Punishments, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and appointed Deputy Commissioner of the Three Commissions;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi, Vice Minister of Punishments, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Deputy Commissioner of the Three Commissions;

sentences.zh: 以禮部侍郎盧價為刑部侍郎；

translations.literal: Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Punishments;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Punishments;

sentences.zh: 以樞密直學士、左散騎常侍邊光範為禮部侍郎充職。

translations.literal: and Bian Guangfan, Academician on Direct Duty at the Bureau of Military Affairs and Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Rites to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: and Bian Guangfan, Direct Academician of the Military Affairs Bureau and Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was appointed Vice Minister of Rites to fill the post.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·邊光範傳》：少帝以光範藩邸舊僚，待遇尤厚。

translations.literal: (Biography of Bian Guangfan, History of Song: The young emperor, seeing that Guangfan was an old associate from his princely household, treated him with especial generosity.
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Bian Guangfan: The young emperor had known Guangfan as a companion in his princely establishment and treated him with especial favor.

sentences.zh: 因遊宴，見光範位翰林學士下，即日拜尚書禮部侍郎、知制誥，充翰林學士，仍直樞密使院。）〉

translations.literal: During a tour and banquet, seeing Guangfan placed below the Hanlin academicians, that same day he appointed him Vice Minister of Rites in the Ministry of Rites, Knowing Imperial Edicts, as Hanlin Academician, while still serving on duty at the Bureau of Military Affairs.))
translations.idiomatic: At a banquet he noticed Guangfan ranked below the Hanlin academicians; that same day he made him Vice Minister of Rites and drafter of imperial edicts, Hanlin Academician, while keeping him on duty at the Military Affairs Bureau.))

sentences.zh: 辛未，以右龍武統軍周密為延州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Zhou Mi, Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made Military Commissioner of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhou Mi, Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was appointed Military Commissioner of Yan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，河東節度使劉知遠奏，誅吐渾大首領白承福、白鐵匱、赫連海龍等，並夷其族凡四百口，蓋利其孳畜財寶也，人皆冤之。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of Hedong, reported that he had executed the great Tuguhun leaders Bai Chengfu, Bai Tiegui, Helian Hailong, and others, and exterminated their clans to the number of four hundred persons—all to seize their herds and treasures; all considered it unjust.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of Hedong, reported that he had put to death the great Tuguhun chiefs Bai Chengfu, Bai Tiegui, Helian Hailong, and others, and exterminated their clans—four hundred persons in all—chiefly to seize their livestock and treasure; all regarded it as a grievous injustice.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以大理少卿劇可久為大理卿。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Ju Kejiu, Vice Director of the Court of Law, was made Director of the Court of Law.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Ju Kejiu, Vice Director of the Court of Law, was appointed Director of the Court of Law.

sentences.zh: 棣州刺史慕容彥超削奪在身官爵，房州安置，坐前任濮州擅出省倉麥及私賣官面，準法處死，太原節度使劉知遠上表救之，故貸其死。

translations.literal: Murong Yanchao, Prefect of Di, was stripped of his present titles and offices and sent to Fang Prefecture for resettlement, on charges that as former Prefect of Pu he had taken grain from the provincial granary without authorization and privately sold official noodles; by law he deserved death, but Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of Taiyuan, memorialized to save him, and so his life was spared.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Yanchao, Prefect of Di, was stripped of his current rank and office and resettled in Fang Prefecture. He had taken grain from the provincial granary without leave and sold official noodles privately while Prefect of Pu; by law he deserved death, but Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan memorialized on his behalf, and his life was spared.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，靈州馮暉奏，與威州刺史藥元福於威州土橋西一百里遇吐蕃七千餘人，大破之，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Feng Hui of Ling Prefecture reported that he and Yao Yuanfu, Prefect of Wei, met more than seven thousand Tibetans a hundred li west of the earthen bridge at Wei Prefecture, routed them utterly, and took more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Feng Hui of Ling reported that he and Yao Yuanfu, Prefect of Wei, met more than seven thousand Tibetans a hundred li west of Wei's earthen bridge, routed them completely, and took more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 是月，秦州雨，兩旬不止，鄴都雨水一丈，洛京、鄭州、貝州大水，鄴都、夏津臨清兩縣，餓死民凡三千三百。

translations.literal: That month, Qin Prefecture had rain for twenty days without stop; Yedu had rainwater to a height of one zhang; Luoyang, Zheng, and Bei had great floods; in Yedu and the two counties of Xiajin and Linqing, three thousand three hundred commoners starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qin Prefecture rained twenty days without cease; at Yedu the floodwaters stood one zhang deep; Luoyang, Zheng, and Bei suffered great floods; and in Yedu and the counties of Xiajin and Linqing, three thousand three hundred people starved to death.

sentences.zh: 盜入臨濮、費縣。

translations.literal: Bandits entered Linpu and Fei counties.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits raided Linpu and Fei counties.

sentences.zh: 秋九月壬辰，鄆州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使李守貞加兼侍中，滑州節度使皇甫遇進封邠國公，相州節度使張彥澤加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: In autumn, on the ninth month, day renchen, Li Shouzhen, Military Commissioner of Yan and Commander of the Palace Personal Guard, was additionally made Palace Attendant; Huangfu Yu, Military Commissioner of Hua, was advanced to Duke of Bin; Zhang Yanze, Military Commissioner of Xiang, was made Acting Grand Preceptor.
