translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on renchen of the ninth month, Li Shouzhen, Military Commissioner of Yan and Commander of the Palace Guard, was additionally made Palace Attendant; Huangfu Yu of Hua was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin; and Zhang Yanze of Xiang was made Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以權知威武軍節度使李宏達為檢校太尉、同平章事，充福建節度使，知閩國事。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Li Hongda, acting Military Commissioner of the Weiwu Army, was made Acting Grand Preceptor and Co-Chancellor, and made Military Commissioner of Fujian, governing Min affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Li Hongda, acting Military Commissioner of the Weiwu Army, was made Acting Grand Preceptor and Co-Chancellor, appointed Military Commissioner of Fujian, and charged with governing Min.

sentences.zh: 乙未，前商州刺史李俊賜自盡，坐與親妹奸及行劍斫殺女使，又殺部曲孫漢榮，強奸其妻，準法棄市，詔賜死於家。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Li Jun, former Prefect of Shang, was granted suicide, having committed incest with his younger sister by blood, slashed a maid with a sword, murdered his follower Sun Hanrong, and raped his wife; by law merited execution in the marketplace; the edict granted death at home.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Li Jun, former Prefect of Shang, was granted suicide. He had lain with his own sister, hacked a maid with a sword, murdered his retainer Sun Hanrong, and raped Sun's wife; by law he merited public execution, but the edict allowed him to die at home.

sentences.zh: 己亥，張彥澤奏，破蕃賊於定州界，斬首二十餘級，追襲百餘里，生擒蕃將四人，摘得金耳環二副進呈。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Zhang Yanze reported breaking barbarian forces at the border of Ding, beheading more than twenty, pursuing over a hundred li, capturing four barbarian generals alive, and presenting two pairs of gold earrings taken from them.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zhang Yanze reported that he had routed Khitan forces on the Ding border, taken more than twenty heads, pursued them over a hundred li, captured four Khitan generals alive, and presented two pairs of gold earrings taken from the enemy.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太原奏，破契丹於楊武谷，殺七千餘人。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Taiyuan reported routing Khitan at Yangwu Valley, killing more than seven thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Taiyuan reported a victory over the Khitan at Yangwu Valley, with more than seven thousand killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以天策上將軍、江南諸道都統、楚王馬希範兼諸道兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Ma Xifan, Grand General of the Heaven's Strategy, Overall Commander of the Jiangnan Circuits, and King of Chu, was additionally made Supreme Commander of All Circuits' Armies and Horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Ma Xifan, Grand General of the Heaven's Strategy, Overall Commander of the Jiangnan circuits, and King of Chu, was additionally made Supreme Commander of Armies and Horses of All Circuits.

sentences.zh: 詔開封府，以霖雨不止，應京城公私僦舍錢放一月。

translations.literal: An edict to the Kaifeng prefecture: because incessant rain continued, rents on public and private leased dwellings in the capital were remitted for one month.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Kaifeng prefecture ordered that, because the rains would not cease, rents on public and private leased dwellings in the capital be remitted for one month.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔安審琦率兵赴鄴都，皇甫遇赴相州。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict ordered An Shenqi to lead troops to Yedu and Huangfu Yu to proceed to Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict ordered An Shenqi to lead troops to Yedu and Huangfu Yu to Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以太子少保楊凝式為太子少傅，以刑部尚書王延為太子少保，前潁州團練使竇貞固為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Yang Ningshi, Vice Protector of the Crown Prince, was made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Wang Yan, Minister of Punishments, was made Vice Protector; and Dou Zhengu, former Military Training Commissioner of Ying, was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yang Ningshi was moved from Vice Protector to Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Wang Yan, Minister of Punishments, became Vice Protector; and Dou Zhengu, former Military Training Commissioner of Ying, was made Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南、河北、關西諸州奏，大水霖雨不止，溝河泛濫，水入城郭及損害秋稼。

translations.literal: That month, provinces of Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi reported great floods and unceasing rain; ditches and rivers overflowed; water entered city walls and damaged autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: That month the provinces of Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi reported ceaseless rains and great floods; ditches and rivers burst their banks, water entered the cities, and the autumn harvest was ruined.

sentences.zh: 是月，契丹瀛州刺史詐為書與樂壽將軍王巒，願以本城歸順，且言城中蕃軍不滿千人，請朝廷發軍襲取之，己為內應。

translations.literal: That month, the Khitan Prefect of Ying forged a letter to Wang Luan, general of Yueshou, offering to surrender the city in submission, saying Khitan troops in the city numbered fewer than a thousand, asking the court to send forces to seize it while he would serve as insider.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Khitan prefect of Ying forged a letter to Wang Luan, general of Yueshou, offering to surrender the city and claiming that fewer than a thousand Khitan troops remained inside; he asked the court to send an army to seize it while he would act as insider.

sentences.zh: 又云：「今秋苦雨，川澤漲溢，自瓦橋已北，水勢無際。

translations.literal: It also said: "This autumn the rains have been bitter; rivers and marshes have risen and overflowed. From Waqiao northward the waters are boundless."
translations.idiomatic: The letter also said: "This autumn the rains have been relentless; rivers and marshes have swollen. From Waqiao northward the floodwaters stretch without end."

sentences.zh: 契丹已歸本國，若聞南夏有變，地遠阻水，雖欲奔命，無能及也。

translations.literal: "The Khitan have returned to their own country. If they hear trouble in the Southern Dynasty, the distance is far and waters block the way; even if they wished to rush to the rescue, they could not arrive in time."
translations.idiomatic: "The Khitan have already returned home. If they hear of trouble in the south, the distance is great and the waters block the way; even if they wished to hurry to the rescue, they could not arrive in time."

sentences.zh: 」又，巒繼有密奏，苦言瀛、鄚可取之狀。

translations.literal: Moreover, Luan followed with secret memorials urgently detailing how Ying and Mo could be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Luan then sent further secret memorials urgently arguing that Ying and Mo could be seized.

sentences.zh: 先是，前歲中車駕駐於河上，曾遣邊將遺書於幽州趙延壽，勸令歸國，延壽尋有報命，依違而已。

translations.literal: Previously, in the year before, when the imperial carriage was stationed on the Yellow River, border generals had been sent with a letter to Zhao Yanshou at Youzhou urging him to return to the state; Yanshou soon replied, but remained evasive.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the year before the imperial carriage had been stationed on the Yellow River, border generals were sent with a letter to Zhao Yanshou at Youzhou urging him to return to the dynasty; Yanshou soon replied, but remained noncommittal.

sentences.zh: 是歲三月，復遣鄴都杜威致書於延壽，且述朝旨，啖以厚利，仍遣洺州軍將趙行實賫書而往，潛申款密。

translations.literal: That year in the third month, Du Wei of Yedu was again sent with a letter to Yanshou, stating the court's intent and tempting him with rich rewards; the army officer Zhao Xingshi of Ming Prefecture was sent bearing the letter, conveying secret expressions of goodwill.
translations.idiomatic: That year in the third month, Du Wei of Yedu was again sent to write Yanshou, setting forth the court's intent and tempting him with rich rewards; the Ming army officer Zhao Xingshi carried the letter and conveyed secret pledges of goodwill.

sentences.zh: 行實曾事延壽，故遣之。

translations.literal: Xingshi had once served Yanshou, and so was sent for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: Xingshi had once served under Yanshou, and was sent for that reason.

sentences.zh: 七月，行實自燕回，得延壽書，且言：「久陷邊庭，願歸中國，乞發大軍應接，即拔身南去。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Xingshi returned from Yan with Yanshou's letter, which said: "Long trapped on the frontier, I wish to return to China; I beg the court to send a great army to meet me, and I will at once flee south."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Xingshi returned from Yan with Yanshou's letter, which said: "Long trapped on the frontier, I wish to return to China; send a great army to meet me, and I will flee south at once."

sentences.zh: 」敘致懇切，辭旨綿密，時朝廷欣然從之，復遣趙行實計會延壽大軍應接之所。

translations.literal: The wording was earnest and the arguments close-knit; the court gladly assented and again sent Zhao Xingshi to arrange where Yanshou's main force would link up.
translations.idiomatic: The tone was earnest and the arguments meticulous; the court gladly assented and again sent Zhao Xingshi to arrange where Yanshou's main force would rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 有瀛州大將遣所親賫蠟書至闕下，告雲欲謀翻變，以本城歸命。

translations.literal: A great general of Ying sent a close associate bearing a sealed letter to the court reporting a planned mutiny to surrender the city.
translations.idiomatic: A senior officer of Ying sent a close associate with a sealed letter to the court, reporting a planned defection to surrender the city.

sentences.zh: 未幾，會彼有告變者，事不果就。

translations.literal: Before long, someone there reported the plot, and the affair came to nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Before long someone there exposed the plot, and the affair came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 至是，瀛州守將劉延祚受契丹之命，詐輸誠款，以誘我軍，國家深以為信，遂有出師之議。

translations.literal: Now, Liu Yanzuo, the Ying garrison commander, acting on Khitan orders, feigned sincere submission to lure our army; the state placed deep faith in this, and thus the debate to launch a campaign arose.
translations.idiomatic: Now Liu Yanzuo, the Ying garrison commander, acting on Khitan orders, feigned submission to lure our army; the court placed deep faith in him, and thus arose the debate to march out.
